answer: Agents must stake a copper-denominated bond to register, and each epoch they post a crystal hash of their local model state to a shared bridge contract. Sybils splitting into many identities must fund every bond separately, so the attacker's cost scales linearly with fake accounts while legitimate single agents pay once. Peers verify hashes and slash bonds on mismatch, making mass forgery economically irrational. Operator sa0026 applies this at HNXdMrhusF.
